reviews.review_description:
You have to pay to customize your character, which just sucks because customization is pretty important when it's advertised so much. 

Devs, please make it free!

developer_response.body:
Hi RODOG0914, thank you so much for playing Vice Miami and for taking the time to share your feedback! 🙏

You’re absolutely right that character customization is a big part of the experience. It’s one of the features we care about most, and we’ve put a lot of work into the outfits and styles. That’s why it’s part of our premium content, which helps us keep developing and improving the game.

We also have some exciting news: multiplayer mode is coming soon! Once it launches, you’ll be able to show off your outfits and style to your friends in the club, so your customization will matter even more.

We’re always listening to players, so your feedback really helps shape future updates. Stay tuned, more is on the way! 🎉

— The Vice Miami Team

reviews.review_description: This game is not great. But in free games category I have to say it's a nice game..you can drive cars interact with civilians and explore new locations in city...but it ould be more fun if I can play it with friends....Soo please make a multiplayer mode in it...

developer_response.body: Thank you so much for your feedback and suggestion! ❤️ We’re happy to let you know that multiplayer mode is now available! 🎮🥳 Go check it out and enjoy playing with your friends. We really appreciate your support and hope you have an amazing time in Vice Miami! 🙌

reviews.review_description:
Why don't you finish the game before submitting it. GTA 6 IS ABOUT TO DROP...AND THIS IS WHAT YOU BRING US SMH

I CAN'T EVEN GIVE YOU CONSTRUCTIVE CRITICISM YOU LITERALLY DID NOTHING IN THE GAME 

I'D REALLY JUST SAY FIND A NEW HOBBY

developer_response.body: Hey man, gotta be real, this one hurt a little! We've poured a lot of late nights and effort into Vice Miami. But comparing us to GTA 6 isn't really a fair fight bro. That's a AAA game with thousands of devs and a massive budget, and we're just a small indie team doing our best. That said, we genuinely appreciate you taking the time to leave feedback. If you tell us what exactly felt unfinished (bugs, missing features, anything), we'll look into it for the next updates. We're still building and improving this game every week. Thanks for playing! 🙏

reviews.review_description: I cannot even move around without intense bugs , the Calibration is very bad . I’ve tried re starting my headset 10 times but my legs fall through the floor everytime I get into the game . Shame

developer_response.body:
Thank you for reporting this issue. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the movement bugs and calibration problems. 🙏

Our development team is actively working on identifying and fixing these issues to improve the overall gameplay experience. We understand how frustrating it is when your character's legs fall through the floor or movement doesn't work as expected, and we're taking this feedback seriously.

We're working on a fix and aim to resolve these problems as soon as possible in an upcoming update. Please keep your game updated to the latest version.

Thank you for your patience and for helping us improve Vice Miami. We truly appreciate your support! ❤️
